lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized into approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spots exhibit a grid-like alignment with horizontal spacing roughly twice that of the vertical spacing between adjacent blobs within a column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the circular high-luminance blobs. These vertical bands and the horizontal arrangement of spots create a visible grid of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-colored upper surfaces and shadowed lower surfaces, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.
